title: U.S. utility-scale battery capacity: End of 2023
summary: EIA reported 575 operating batteries with 15,814 MW of utility-scale power capacity at the end of 2023. Facility count and power capacity are separate measures.
key_findings: EIA reported 575 operating batteries with 15,814 MW of utility-scale power capacity at the end of 2023.
Method: EIA survey and operating-generator data for utility-scale battery storage.
Denominator: Operating U.S. utility-scale battery storage capacity at the stated date.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the u.s. utility-scale battery capacity series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for asset-level grid, water, storage, and mineral performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Facility count and power capacity are separate measures.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Operating U.S. utility-scale battery storage capacity at the stated date.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
